title: NEB Class 11 Biology — Conservation Biology — 2024
subject: biology
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: What is biodiversity? Explain the levels of biodiversity and their significance.
questions.solution:
**Biodiversity:** Variety of life at all levels.

**Levels:**
1. **Genetic diversity** — variation within species (crop varieties, breeds)
2. **Species diversity** — number and abundance of species
3. **Ecosystem diversity** — variety of habitats and ecological processes

**Significance:** Ecosystem stability, resource provision (food, medicine), cultural value.
questions.knowledgeNote: Nepal has 44 protected areas. Chitwan National Park (UNESCO site) is a biodiversity hotspot.
questions.answer: **Biodiversity:** the **variety and variability of all life** on earth — every species, every genetic variant and every ecosystem — the total living wealth of the biosphere (the term combines 'biological' and 'diversity'). **Three levels of biodiversity:** **(1) Genetic diversity:** variation of **genes within a species** — different varieties/strains/races (e.g. thousands of traditional rice landraces in Nepal; different breeds of dogs). **Significance:** the raw material for adaptation and breeding — a genetically uniform crop is one disease away from disaster (Irish potato famine). **(2) Species diversity:** the **variety of species** in a region or the biosphere — Nepal alone holds ~900 bird and ~180 mammal species. **Significance:** each species is an irreplaceable component of ecosystems and a potential resource (food, medicine). **(3) Ecosystem (community) diversity:** the **variety of habitats, ecosystems and communities** — Nepal ranges from Terai grasslands and subtropical forests to alpine meadows and the high Himalaya within 200 km. **Significance:** ecosystems deliver services (water, climate regulation, soil) and shelter the other two levels. **Deep point:** the three levels are nested — genes make species, species make ecosystems — and conserving only the middle level is like saving the books while burning the library.
